title: Aisha — Morning priority docket (week 11)
content:
Quick, messy morning log — working list for today (notes to self).

TOP 3 (today)
- Finalize Dedicated pricing proposal for exec review (aim to ship to finance by EOD). Key ask: confirm 6 vs 12 month commit discount bands. (See Confluence link)
- 1:1 prep with CEO (09:30): status on Private deployment pilots, blockers on KMS integrations, risks for EMEA rollout. Bring two mitigation options for KMS vendor delays.
- Block 11:00–12:00 for Partner deep-dive w/ Solutions Eng (Diego) — review customer X perf numbers and tuning plan (quantization profile choices).

MEETING NOTES / ACTIONS
- 09:30 1:1 CEO: draft short agenda
  * 2 min recap: last week wins (late-night rollout success)
  * ask: approval to accelerate Private pilot for bank client (needs HSM)
  * decision needed: accept vendor SOW for HSM testing (cost impact)
  Action: Samir to run final cost delta by 4pm.

- 11:00 Partner deep-dive (Diego)
  * Diego to present perf table: p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost/unit for candidate models
  * My ask: prioritize two model variants to test (quantized 4-bit and fp16)
  Action: Diego -> run controlled A/B by Thursday; deliver baseline notebook link.

- 14:00 Product sync: rollout policy defaults + canary thresholds
  * Confirm default canary size (5% vs 10%) and rollback window (10m vs 30m)
  * Ask infra: are we able to do per-customer canary configs? If not, note for roadmap.

FOLLOW-UPS (by owner)
- Follow-up w/ Legal on updated enterprise terms for Dedicated (data residency clause) — email sent, need redline by Friday.
- Remind CS (Maya) to schedule feedback call with customer Y about model quality drift monitoring.
- Ops: validate that autoscaling burst capacity can be toggled per-customer; ticket exists (JIRA-4798).

RISKS / FLAGS
- KMS vendor timeline slipping — plan fallback: short-term HSM emulation + accelerated audit. 
- EMEA infra credits low for Q2 — check procurement runway.
- Potential perf regression on 32k-context models after latest kernel swap — add to regression watchlist.

NOTES TO SELF / DO NOT FORGET
- Bring the 2-slide pricing delta to the exec readout (slide 1 = price bands, slide 2 = customer impact examples).
- Call with procurement at 16:00 — confirm cloud commit windows.
- Batch tuning experiment: increase batch size cap for seq<=512 to reduce per-token cost; test memory pressure.

QUICK TODO (today) — tick off as done:
- [ ] Finalize pricing doc for finance
- [x] Review nightly rollout logs (no major errors)
- [ ] Send follow-up to Legal
- [ ] Prep 1:1 CEO bullets
- [ ] Confirm time for customer Y feedback call

PARKING LOT (later this week)
- Revisit canary metrics: add quality fallback triggers (not just latency/errors).
- Draft short internal note on cost-optimization wins from caching heuristics.
- Prep blurb for all-hands on Dedicated launch windows.

RANDOM LINKS/REFS
- Pricing draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PRICING/Dedicated+pricing+v2
- JIRA: JIRA-4821 (Dedicated pricing), JIRA-4798 (autoscale per-customer)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/rw-console/pull/314 (canary UI change)

END — capture fire-drills during day here, will flush to formal notes after EOD.

(voice: terse, checklist-forward, will expand into formal doc if decisions made)
